fullC_definition: All columns of three query relations plus users declared-FK closure; all source NOT NULL, PK, UNIQUE and FK, native type value domains, complete projects.* output. No inherited SQLite boolean encoding.

engine_provenance.source_schema_family: POSTGRESQL (enable_extension plpgsql/pg_trgm at schema lines 17-18 and PostgreSQL index opclasses)
engine_provenance.source_query_execution_engine: NOT_IDENTIFIED_DIRECTLY; source SQL f literal is compatible with PostgreSQL
engine_provenance.requirements: Parent requirements lines 142-144 state PostgreSQL >=9.2 and recommend9.6; not proof of actual server version
engine_provenance.new_engine_profile: Parent runner plans PostgreSQL16.14, C locale, UTF8, task-private Unix socket and no TCP; runtime acceptance recorded separately
engine_provenance.database_yml: Exact parent PostgreSQL template declares adapter postgresql and encoding unicode; template is not deployment evidence

rails_resolution.string_limit_result: No source limit on all40 string columns; PG adapter string has no native limit; type_to_sql appends a width only when explicit/native limit exists. Correct new-PG schema-load mapping is VARCHAR with no typmod, not VARCHAR(255).
rails_resolution.implicit_id: create_table default id -> primary_key native serial primary key (abstract205-214, adapter80). Catalog INTEGER carries same int32 values; DB DDL preserves sequence default.

collation_policy.source_declaration: UNSPECIFIED (no explicit collation in selected source declarations)
collation_policy.postgres_ddl: Inherit replay database default; no source collation is guessed or added
collation_policy.catalog: ColumnDecl.collation remains None as in source declaration; native PostgreSQL equality; selected C-locale calibration must be attested by runner
collation_policy.explicit_collation_support_limit: ParSEval Catalog _key_inactive_reason lines555-559 marks any explicit collated key inactive. Do not add a guessed CollationId or suppress an actual explicit one. A changed source requiring explicit collation needs new audit.
collation_policy.scope: No all-locale equivalence or historical server reproduction claimed. Conservative text-key values and PostgreSQL constraint acceptance are required for retained generated instances.

source_C_preservation.catalog_implicit_sequence_allocation: not modeled; every generated row must supply every column, including IDs
source_C_preservation.on_delete_cascade: retained in backend DDL; Catalog query-time FK is MATCH SIMPLE; no mutation/cascade behavior claim
source_C_preservation.nonunique_indexes: Source nonunique performance indexes/pg_trgm extension not required for static relational C and not reproduced. This is not a performance or physical-plan experiment.

adapter.load_schema: stdlib source check, returns ordered table metadata
adapter.make_ddl: returns SERIAL-preserving PostgreSQL DDL string; no execution
adapter.build_catalog: lazy target import; real Catalog APIs; native DATE/TIMESTAMP/BOOLEAN; INTEGER int32; audit required before returning
adapter.audit_catalog: asserts exact per-table constraint signature/nullability/types, all43 proof_active and no additional/unsupported declarations

remaining_runtime_gates: Independent review before target imports or execution
Catalog43 active assertions must pass at runtime
Keep original query hashes; original f literal compatibility owned by parent
Verify target database locale/encoding and source C negative/nullable tests
Reject generated rows failing real PostgreSQL type/domain/constraint checks; do not count backend errors as output differences
remaining_historical_gaps: Actual historical server/version/session/collation/data unknown; not required to claim only new-engine calibration
